name: Metro Simulator: 'Russia' Liveries Pack
summary:
Three paintings which are made according to the real paintings of this train in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, Baku, Azerbaijan and Kazan, Russia (planned). Paintings for Tashkent and Baku also include alternative appearance for headlights.
You can select the needed painting in Free Ride menu. Moreover, you can enable custom paintings for AI-driven trains.
